notes: Everyone stories: a universe with more than one world (like Zenless Zone Zero) now has an Everyone option at the top of its page. Krampus and Yunkui Summit live side by side in one story with every character on their own schedule, and you can meet anyone.
There's no set plot in an Everyone story, so you choose who you are or write your own scene when you start. Both worlds' lorebooks, relationships and phone apps carry over.
